fusions.name: Itching Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Long-Jump Nip
fusions.desc: Leaps at a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Coat Full of Guests
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to shake a cloud of fleas loose from your coat for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 2 damage, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hitchhikers
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a flea leaps from your coat and deals 5 damage to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles. Once every 4 seconds.
